description: TechVault capability. Least-privilege per PHASE_2_MILESTONES M0/P1-I: the frontend uses application-defined commands (never ACL-gated) plus exactly the core APIs it uses. G1 (owner zoom directive): core:webview:allow-set-zoom grants ONLY the document zoom scale — no window, filesystem, or network surface. Later milestones add exactly the permissions they use.
